   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 2, 2026 - Aug 2, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Robert Taylor_, Aug 2, 2026, 2/5: "Too much offered only for more expensive devices. the app doesn't allow me to remove stuff that I can't use. Very frustrating. Supposedly works with Galaxy Fit 3 but too much of the app doesn't work with it. I realize that the app is free but let us pare it down to what we CAN use. Idiotic way to create loyalty - to say the least."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      4 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Aug 4, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Daw's Collection_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "After updating my Galaxy Watch 5 to One UI 8, my smartwatch can't detect that I'm wearing it on my wrist. The AOD doesn't work, and it can't measure heart rate, SPO2 (blood oxygen), or monitor sleep. Please fix the One UI 8 watch bug before we move on to your competitors!"
            2. _liz h_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "over a month later still not fixed. unable to enter or edit sleep in the last few days since you pushed out a major change to the look of the app. what have you not tested properly? intriguing reading all the broken app comments & that Samsung have chosen to respond only to a select few. the overriding customer feedback is that the latest update has broken the app, but feedback from Samsung does not provide any indication of a fix. Samsung, put your hands up, admit the mistake and get it fixed."
            3. _Cathy G_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "Latest update has completely broken the app. Any interaction with the home screen causes it to shut down, then it won't reopen unless you force stop it. please fix!!"
